description:
The compact banner hint reads 'ctrl+o more' (implying Ctrl+O expands the banner). The expanded banner confirms '? toggle this banner'. WelcomeBanner.handle_key only responds to Key{key: ??} — not Ctrl+O.

So the compact hint is wrong: it should say '? more' to match the actual handler. The expanded banner also lists 'Ctrl+O show full startup help' — but there is no handle_key clause for Ctrl+O, so that key does nothing.

Needs: either fix the compact hint to say '? more', or implement a Ctrl+O handler for 'show full startup help' and update hints accordingly.
title: WelcomeBanner compact hint says 'ctrl+o more' but actual key is '?'
